title: Parcela Entity Schema v1
description: Defines an Entity (a person or legal entity in the global rolodex). Entities are CROSS-MUNICIPALITY: the same Toll Brothers record is referenced by every municipality in which Toll Brothers files an application. Identity: optional `id` (uuid) is canonical. Otherwise the natural key is `name` (case-insensitive exact match across the global rolodex).

id.description: Stable UUID primary key. When set, this is the canonical identifier across environments.

name.description: Human-readable name. For people, the personal name. For organizations, the registered name. Used as a natural-key fallback when no id is provided.

entity_type.description: What kind of entity this is.

organization.description: Affiliated organization, when distinct from name (e.g. an attorney's firm).
